parameters.query:
SELECT
  ba.rule_id,
  COUNT(*) as total_alerts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN af.verdict IN ('false_positive','noise') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fp_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN af.verdict = 'true_positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tp_count,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN af.verdict IN ('false_positive','noise') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) as fp_rate
FROM bt_alert_log ba
JOIN analyst_feedback af ON ba.event_id = af.alert_id
WHERE ba.processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY ba.rule_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY fp_rate DESC;

INSERT INTO rule_thresholds (rule_id,confidence_threshold,fp_rate,recommendation,updated_at)
SELECT rule_id, COALESCE(new_threshold,75), fp_rate, LOWER(action), NOW()
FROM json_to_recordset('[{"rule_id":"placeholder","fp_rate":0,"action":"no_change","new_threshold":75}]')
  AS t(rule_id text,fp_rate numeric,action text,new_threshold int)
ON CONFLICT (rule_id) DO UPDATE SET confidence_threshold=EXCLUDED.confidence_threshold,
  fp_rate=EXCLUDED.fp_rate, recommendation=EXCLUDED.recommendation, updated_at=NOW();

meta.description: Weekly analysis of alert FP rates per rule. Auto-suppresses rules >30% FP. Reports tuning changes to Detection Engineering.
